title: When Is GMM Actually LATE? Weighting Matrices and Causal Interpretation in Overidentified IV
abstract: arXiv:2604.07131v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Under heterogeneous treatment effects, the weighting matrix of overidentified IV-GMM selects the estimand, not just its precision. We characterize the selection exactly: for any parameter-free weighting-matrix map, the GMM estimand is a sum-to-one combination of instrument-specific Wald estimands, with closed-form weights and an exact non-negativity condition; efficient weighting adds a heterogeneity penalty. Continuously updated GMM exits this class through a variance-score remainder. Under positive regression dependence each Wald estimand is a convex combination of compliance-type LATEs, and under maintained validity a $J$-rejection indicates unequal Wald estimands rather than invalid instruments. translated_title: GMM何时实际上是LATE？过度识别工具变量法中的加权矩阵与因果解释
translated_abstract: 在处理效应存在异质性的条件下，过度识别IV-GMM的加权矩阵选择的不仅是估计的精度，更是估计对象本身。我们精确刻画了这种选择机制：对于任何不含参数的加权矩阵映射，GMM估计对象是各工具变量特定Wald估计对象的权重之和为一的组合，具有闭式权重及精确的非负性条件；而有效（efficient）加权会额外引入一个异质性惩罚项。连续更新（continuously updated）GMM则通过一个方差得分余项脱离了这一类别。在正回归依存的条件下，每个Wald估计对象都是依从性类型LATE的凸组合；并且在维持工具变量有效性的前提下，J统计量的拒绝表明的是各Wald估计对象不相等，而非工具变量无效。我们提出了代表性目标法（Representativeness Targeting, RT），该方法在无需对各矩条件施加共同系数的情况下，估计由研究者指定的Wald估计对象的凸组合；RT对依从性类型赋予非负权重，并能达到局……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明在处理效应异质时，过度识别IV-GMM的加权矩阵本质上决定了估计对象（即各工具变量Wald估计量的特定组合），并据此提出代表性目标法（RT），使研究者可以指定并估计Wald估计量的凸组合而无需假设各矩条件共享同一系数。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that under heterogeneous treatment effects, the weighting matrix of overidentified IV-GMM selects the estimand as a closed-form combination of instrument-specific Wald estimands, and proposes Representativeness Targeting (RT) to estimate a researcher-specified convex combination of these estimands without imposing a common coefficient across moments.
